data_infos.source: https://udb.moe.edu.tw/download/udata/static_file/114/學12-3.新生(含境外生)註冊率-以「校」統計.csv
data_infos.source_type: 教育部大專校院校務資訊公開 UDB 靜態 CSV
data_infos.dataset_description: 教育部大專校院校務資訊公開的校級新生（含境外生）註冊率。本DAG以教育部統計處 student.csv 的學校代碼／名稱與縣市欄位建立校址縣市對照，只保留校址在新北市的學校；輸出E欄百分比，value_type為rate。來源沒有學生年齡，18-35為unavailable。
data_infos.etl_description: Fetch the specified UDB registration-rate CSV with a browser User-Agent and percent-encoded URL, probing the other requested static directories and preferring the newest copy for duplicate academic years. Build a school-to-county crosswalk from MOE student.csv by school code first and school name second, normalising pre-reform county names and failing loudly if any UDB school remains unresolved. Filter by campus county New Taipei City. Parse A-D counts and the rate as a percentage, supporting current D/E and legacy E/D labels; ... is suppression and is not zero. Keep the source counts in breakdown for audit, validate the source formula when all four inputs are visible, allow and record the source's 100% cap, count suppressed rate cells, and apply a three-times annual median-rate scale guard. Rates are not summed or converted to an 18-35 rate.
